product.olivetti-m6-950.summary: The entry-level variant of the Olivetti Pentium Pro platform in the guide.
product.olivetti-m6-950.history: Olivetti’s guide groups it with the M6-950, Modulo PRO 180 and M6-6200 on the same Pentium Pro platform.
product.olivetti-m6-950.architecture: All three share a board and processor socket. The BA2261 uses Socket 8 and the Pentium Pro includes 256 KB of L2 cache.
product.olivetti-m6-950.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m6-950.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m6-950.service-guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, vol. II, ch. 18
product.olivetti-m6-950.firmware: The revision helps identify the service BIOS. The guide lists 1.00.03.CG0.
